items.lede: Spotify says it has removed more than 50 million songs considered AI-generated slop or spam from user recommendations over the past year. items.title: Spotify is dancing around its AI 'slop and spam' problem

items.lede: Enthusiasts like Grimes and A$AP Rocky may embrace AI-generated content, but they won’t produce it themselves Streaming services, notable musicians and fans are confronting the growing presence of AI-generated music and drawing lines in the sand.
